name: How long does bathroom painting and trim work usually take?
description: A simple bathroom paint-and-trim job often takes 1–2 days, but repairs, prep, or cabinet work can extend the timeline.

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom painting and trim work usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the bathroom is dry and the surfaces are in decent shape, many projects can be completed in **one to two days**. More time may be needed if there is drywall repair, peeling paint, damaged trim, or cabinet refinishing.
